QuestInfo.name: [Freud's Journal] The Pendant Released
QuestInfo.0: The spirit of the pendant wants to tell you how to release its sealed powers. Speak to it.
QuestInfo.1: The spirit of the pendant says it will share its power and Freud's memories only with good people. Eliminate 999 evil monsters to prove your goodness.\r\n\r\n#rCaution! You must have the Sealed Sylph Pendant in your inventory when you complete this quest.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated 999 evil monsters and released the pendant's powers. The pendant is Freud's gift to you and will make you stronger. However, Freud said this pendant is merely a decoration. What does he mean?
